rule.name: UnorderedQuery
rule.message: This query takes a page of rows (setMaxResults, setFirstResult, an unsorted PageRequest passed to findAll, or SQL LIMIT, OFFSET or FETCH) or builds an array_agg, json_agg or jsonb_agg list with no ORDER BY, so which rows come back, and in which order, is up to the database and can change between runs. Order on a unique key, or add a tie-breaker after a non-unique key: order by a.createdAt desc, a.id in the query text, criteria.orderBy(...), PageRequest.of(page, size, Sort.by("createdAt", "id")), or json_agg(t.name order by t.name). setMaxResults(1) or LIMIT 1 is fine when the query selects only a constant or a count. An exception fits only a query whose rows come back in one order anyway, or a nested list that is a set whose callers never depend on its order.
